jenna_ae: Heads-up — enterprise buyer asking for detailed KMS/HSM controls. They want: customer-managed keys, attestable HSM (FIPS/HSM), key rotation proof, and confirmation that rekeying won't cause downtime. Can we assemble answers + artifacts by EOD?

alex.r: Short answer: Yes for Private and Dedicated via customer KMS integrations. At-rest uses envelope encryption; data keys generated per-tenant and wrapped by your KMS/HSM. In-transit uses TLS 1.3 with mTLS to internal services.

mark_sec: Add: We support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault for CMK wrapping. For on-prem HSM we integrate via PKCS#11 or HSM-backed KMS proxies. HSM attestation: we can provide HSM module certs and FIPS 140-2/3 details where applicable.

priya.s: Need artifacts list for security review. I propose: (1) short KMS architecture diagram, (2) sample key rotation playbook (steps + rollback), (3) configuration snippet for customer KMS, (4) CAIQ/SIG excerpt for crypto controls, (5) SOC2 crypto control page screenshots. Agree?

alex.r: I'll paste a minimal config snippet they can test in POC:

```
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
  wrap: envelope
  rotate_policy: automatic
```

Also: rotation supports staged key versions — we keep the old data-key to decrypt until re-encryption completes. That enables zero-downtime for reads/writes.

mark_sec: Important: we never store plaintext customer master keys. Data keys are generated in HSM/KMS and the ciphertext blob is stored. Re-encrypt flow uses dual-write during transition window. We'll provide the playbook with timing expectations (~5–15 min per tenant depending on data size).

jenna_ae: Customer also asked: do we support customer rotation on their schedule (they do monthly)?

alex.r: Yes — we can accept external rotation events. For hosted customers we can rotate on-behalf if customer grants key access; for Private they retain KMS control entirely. We log rotation events and produce audit evidence.

infra-bot: deploy-check: private-agent-1 reported KMS proxy cert renewed successfully :white_check_mark:

priya.s: Ok I'll bundle docs. Action items: Alex — produce config + rotation playbook by 3pm. Mark — extract CAIQ crypto answers & HSM certs. Jenna — I'll own delivery to customer and schedule POC test where they trigger a rotation.

alex.r: On it. I'll also add a small test script to validate re-encrypt: `./scripts/rekey-test --tenant X`

mark_sec: I'll redact any sensitive bits and add references to our policies.

jenna_ae: thanks team :pray:
